hints.title: Greedy Bottom-Up Camera Placement
hints.text: Leaf nodes should never host cameras because placing cameras on their parents covers strictly more nodes.

hints.title: Node Monitoring Three-State Classification
hints.text: Classify each node into one of three states: 0 for uncovered, 1 for camera installed, and 2 for covered without camera.

hints.title: Post-Order State Propagation
hints.text: Traverse post-order. Null nodes are treated as covered (state 2). If either child is uncovered (state 0), current node must install a camera (increment count, return 1). Else if either child has a camera (state 1), current node is covered (return 2). Else return 0. If root returns 0, add 1 camera.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Top-down placement must consider branching coverage combinations, resulting in exponential complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bottom-up post-order greedy state evaluation processes each node in O(1) time using recursion stack space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should clearly explain the 3-state system and why leaf nodes never host cameras in an optimal solution.
complexity.notes: Checking if root returns 0 handles root not being covered by any child camera.
